messages:
anya: Quick preflight for Friday's announce  need confirmed prod changelog anchor, CDN hero + small image paths, the exact announce timestamp, and lead webhook routing. Who's got ownership for each item?

sophie: I'm on changelog & docs. Draft is ready; will merge tonight so prod anchor is stable by T-90m. I'll post exact URL after the build: docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-28#notes.

eli: Webinar timing suggestion: announce at 11:00 PT, webinar at 11:05 PT. That gives 5 minutes for social + organic clicks to arrive. Is that okay with ops?

marco: Ops: canary plan is 10% at T0 for 5m, 50% next 5m, then 100%. Recommend announce when canary at 50% (safer). If we want that, schedule announce at 11:05 PT and webinar 11:10 PT.

anya: Hmm prefer announce before webinar by ~5m so people can register. Sophie, can you guarantee docs anchor by T-60m if we keep announce at 11:00 PT?

sophie: Yes, I'll merge at T-120m to let docs publish and CDN warm. Anchor will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-28#rollout-fallbacks once live.

lina: Sales needs the webhook to accept a JSON payload with utm params and return a route header. Current endpoint: https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/announce. Ops, please confirm HMAC config.

ops-bot: Ops note: X-Sales-Signature HMAC header enabled. Scheduled deploy windows: canary 6187656600, ramp 6187656900. Healthchecks will run at T-2m and T+1m.

marco: Confirmed handshake with sales webhook on test payload. It returns X-Route-Group and X-Lead-ID headers. I'll ensure secrets rotated and test logs visible to sales.

anya: Asset links for creative (prod): hero https://cdn.redwood.ai/launch/28mar/hero-wide.png, compact https://cdn.redwood.ai/launch/28mar/bench-compact.png (alt texts stored in asset manager). Use hero for blog and compact for tweet thread.

eli: Social copy draft for A/B: A) "Cut inference costs with smarter batching  join our live demo." B) "See our new fail-safe fallbacks in action  live demo Fri 11:05 PT." We'll A/B subject lines in email too.

lina: Lead routing rules summarized: employee_count >= 750 => enterprise; 100-749 => midmarket; <100 => nurture. Sales SLA: enterprise touch in <1hr. Posting mapping to Confluence now.

ops-bot: Healthcheck T-30m snapshot: /v1/announce/health 200 OK, p95 37ms. No alerts. Rollback criteria: revert canary if 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 3m.

anya: Two quick asks before I lock: 1) Sophie paste final prod anchor URL here; 2) Marco confirm the announce endpoint /v1/announce will be 200 at T0 and that automation will post to the sales hook with utm params.

sophie: Anchor is live: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-28#rollout-fallbacks. Changelog short for social: "Smarter adaptive batching, lower cost per token, graceful quantized fallbacks, and streaming fixes." Keep it concise.

marco: /v1/announce health will be polled at T-2m. Ops automation will send `POST https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/announce` with body including utm_campaign=announce-2026-03-28 and header X-Sales-Signature. I confirmed test POST logs and route headers.

eli: Nice. Can we also get a tiny verification endpoint for marketing to hit that returns the anchor + image list so we can programmatically sanity check before publish?

marco: Adding /internal/announce/verify returning plain-text lines (anchor, hero, compact) now. Will be live by T-3h.

lina: Also, please include query param ?src=announce in registration links so Sales can identify inbound flow. Eg: https://redwood.ai/register?src=announce&utm_campaign=announce-2026-03-28&utm_variant=A

anya: Perfect. Final timing decision: announce at 11:00 PT, webinar 11:05 PT? Or 11:05/11:10 as marco suggested? We need to pick.

marco: If you want maximum safety, wait to 11:05 so canary is at 50%. But if you want the earlier announce window for webinar momentum, 11:00 is acceptable; we'll monitor more aggressively. Your call.

anya: Let's compromise: announce at 11:02 PT, webinar at 11:07 PT. That gives us a bit of canary warm-up and a 5m register window. Marco, will that fit your rollout timings?

marco: Yes. I'll start canary at 11:00 PT so by 11:02 we should be ~20-30%. I'll post healthcheck at 11:00:30 and 11:00:90.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by marco: canary 6187659720, ramp 6187660020. Healthcheck plan posted to ops-channel.

anya: Great locking announce 11:02 PT, webinar 11:07 PT. Sophie, Lina, please paste final copy + registration link in this thread by T-10m. We'll publish the bundle to #marketing-announce then.

sophie: Will do. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-28#rollout-fallbacks. Short social line: "Smarter batching + safer fallbacks = lower cost & fewer interruptions. Live demo Fri 11:07 PT  register: https://redwood.ai/register?src=announce&utm_campaign=announce-2026-03-28&utm_variant=A"

lina: Sales webhook test confirmed again. Mapping table link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SALES/announce-routing. I'll post final lead form params by T-30m.

eli: :thumbsup: prepping email variants.

marco: :thumbsup: ops monitoring and rollback rules set. Will watch for error spikes.

anya: Thanks everyone  closing loop. I'll post final asset bundle at T-10m in #marketing-announce and run the publish checklist.
